Still we have strong evidence: HTML 200, vite modules served, graphql works, auth works, DB migrated and seeded, valkey works.

Let me check the .devcontainer/setup.sh to verify the wasm copy step was indeed in the guide path, just to confirm completeness.

Actually I have enough. Let me finalize with success.

Let me just double-check there's no error in the api server startup relating to storage (MinIO) — STORAGE_URL=storage.example.com is a placeholder. Could that break something? The app started fine. Login and graphql work. Storage only needed for file uploads. Let me quickly check if there's any startup storage error. Log showed none.

I'm confident: success.
